message.content:
**Image 1 (reference J55):** Side view of a bilobed dimer — two lobes side-by-side, clear vertical cleft down the middle, roughly squared-off outline.

**Image 2 (grey map):** Same orientation as image 1? **No.** Orientation: **top view (end-on along the dimer axis)** — globular, roughly circular outline, no central bilobed cleft visible. Detergent: **no flat belt/slab/ring**; a few small detached surface blobs/stray densities at edges, no connected micelle-like feature.

**Image 3 (yellow map):** Same orientation as image 1? **No.** Orientation: **top/end-on view (or intermediate tilted-top)** — round, compact blob with no visible bilobe or cleft. Detergent: **no clear flat detergent belt/ring**; some fuzzy, low-resolution fringe densities around the periphery and small detached blobs, but no ordered slab.

**Image 4 (cyan map):** Same orientation as image 1? **No.** Orientation: **not aligned to anything recognizable** — fragmented/disconnected clumps with no intact bilobed dimer shape; likely a poorly resolved or misaligned class average rather than a defined view. Detergent: **no belt/slab/ring**; multiple **stray disconnected blobs** scattered around the main mass.

**Summary:** None of images 2–4 matches the J55 side-view orientation; images 2–3 are top/end-on views, image 4 is a fragmented, uninterpretable map. No detergent belt/slab/ring in any; only stray blobs (minor in 2–3, extensive in 4).
